description: Source code defining the Node class and related functions for representing and manipulating nodes in a computational graph within PyTorch FX framework.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a computational graph, encapsulating operations, inputs, outputs, and metadata within PyTorch FX.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructs a Node instance with specified graph, name, operation type, target, arguments, and metadata.

methods.name: format_node
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string of the node for debugging and visualization.

methods.name: replace_all_uses_with
methods.description: Replaces all usages of this node in the graph with another node.

methods.name: is_impure
methods.description: Determines if the node's operation is impure, affecting dead code elimination.

methods.name: normalized_arguments
methods.description: Returns normalized arguments matching the target's signature, useful for module calls.

methods.name: replace_input_with
methods.description: Replaces an input node with another node within this node's inputs.

methods.name: _rename
methods.description: Renames the node, updating namespace and references.

methods.name: map_arg
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to all Node arguments.

methods.name: map_aggregate
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to all objects within an argument structure.
